Notes.Text:
This update for xen fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2024-21963: out-of-bounds AMD IOMMU Device Table read can lead to unauthorized IOMMU configuration control
  (bsc#1290016).
- CVE-2024-36350,CVE-2024-36357,CVE-2026-0004: transient scheduler microarchitectural side-channels can lead to
  cross-context and cross-guest sensitive data inference (bsc#1290020).
